archiveInfo.title: 2–3 YEARS DAGESTAN
archiveInfo.subtitle: Unofficial Fan Meme Archive & Video Timeline

heroMeme.title: SEND HIM 2-3 YEARS DAGESTAN AND FORGET — The Original Origin Clip
heroMeme.quote: If you want your son high-level wrestling, send him 2–3 years Dagestan and forget.
heroMeme.context: Said completely deadpan to Daniel Cormier when discussing DC's son's wrestling training. The single sentence that birthed a global internet meme culture.

timestampedMemes.title: Send Him 2-3 Years Dagestan And Forget (The Original)
timestampedMemes.quote: If you want your son high-level wrestling, send him 2–3 years Dagestan and forget.
timestampedMemes.context: The birth of the world-famous meme. Said to DC regarding his son's athletic future.

timestampedMemes.title: Friends? I Think We're Brothers ❤️
timestampedMemes.quote: DC: 'One of my great friends, Islam...' — Islam: 'We're friends? I think we're brothers.'
timestampedMemes.context: The wholesome foundation behind 10 years of ruthless gym banter at AKA.

timestampedMemes.title: You 190 Fat 😂 (DC Sparring Excuse vs Khabib)
timestampedMemes.quote: How fat are you? Say it... You 190 fat.
timestampedMemes.context: When DC makes the excuse that he's 'too small right now' to grapple Khabib.

timestampedMemes.title: Like Always Number Two (Podcast Rankings Banter)
timestampedMemes.quote: Your podcast is like number two. If I don't open my podcast, you become number three.
timestampedMemes.context: Islam rating DC's podcast subscribers vs Mighty Mouse.

timestampedMemes.title: $2M in Watches (AP1 / 'I Don't Even Set My Watches')
timestampedMemes.quote: What time is it? I have no idea. It's not even Saturday. I don't even set my watches.
timestampedMemes.context: DC calls out Islam's sudden collection of Audemars Piguet, Hublot, and Richard Mille.

timestampedMemes.title: 2-3 Years Dagestan: High School Update (Grilling DC on Son)
timestampedMemes.quote: Show me the numbers bro... When he finally come to Dagestan it's going to be time to retire bro!
timestampedMemes.context: Islam grills DC for still not sending his 15-year-old son to Dagestan for wrestling training.

timestampedMemes.title: It Looks Like AI, Right? 🤖 (Deepfake Sparring Excuse)
timestampedMemes.quote: In this world, AI will really confuse you! Did you see the video? It looks like AI, right?
timestampedMemes.context: DC claiming embarrassing gym sparring footage shown by Ali is deepfake AI.

timestampedMemes.title: Ali Sick on the Couch 🛋️ (Exposing Manager Dodging Sparring)
timestampedMemes.quote: Khabib tell Ali go spar me and he sit on the couch: 'I just feel sick!'
timestampedMemes.context: Exposing manager Ali Abdelaziz dodging sparring sessions at AKA.

timestampedMemes.title: Did He Touch My Heart? (Faceoff Nervous Energy Reaction)
timestampedMemes.quote: From where? Did he touch my heart? Bro, maybe I check by my phone what's the heart rate.
timestampedMemes.context: Islam's deadpan logic when told an opponent sensed 'nervous energy' at the faceoff.

timestampedMemes.title: The 20-Win Quest (Double Champion Legacy Goal)
timestampedMemes.quote: Anderson Silva 16... I want 20. So no, no going to beat this record.
timestampedMemes.context: Islam outlines his goal to defend both belts and hit 20 consecutive UFC wins.

timestampedMemes.title: Give Me Top 15... Or Give Me Brock Lesnar
timestampedMemes.quote: Hey DC, tell this guy I deserve top 15 — or I wanna fight with Brock Lesnar.
timestampedMemes.context: Early callout era while Makhachev was an unranked grinder, fearlessly calling out heavyweight legend Brock Lesnar.

timestampedMemes.title: Islam Calls Out Mayweather — Joe Rogan Shocked
timestampedMemes.quote: Hey Dana, I want a money fight. Give me Mayweather. Woooo!
timestampedMemes.context: Left Joe Rogan stunned on live PPV after finishing Bobby Green, debuting his signature deadpan callout style.

timestampedMemes.title: Submits Oliveira, Becomes Champ — Presser Deadpan
timestampedMemes.quote: I already waiting when he retired... I want to fight for this belt.
timestampedMemes.context: After submitting Charles Oliveira to win the lightweight belt, Islam launched the legendary deadpan press conference era.

timestampedMemes.title: The Australia Trip — Kangaroos Have Good Striking
timestampedMemes.quote: Kangaroo have good striking — but nobody check their grappling.
timestampedMemes.context: During fight week in Perth against Volkanovski, Islam casually analyzed the striking and grappling of Australian wildlife.

timestampedMemes.title: Now I'm The Best Fighter In The World
timestampedMemes.quote: Doesn't matter how I won today. Now I'm not just the champion — I'm the best fighter in the world.
timestampedMemes.context: The full-sentence precursor to his later iconic minimalist one-word answers.

timestampedMemes.title: The One-Word Answer — Best. Fighter. In. The. World. (UFC 311)
timestampedMemes.context: Islam masters the ultimate minimal-word press conference response when asked how to describe himself.

timestampedMemes.title: Not All Wealthy People Are Happy 🤲 (Family & Faith Values)
timestampedMemes.quote: Not all wealthy people are happy. Happiness doesn't come from money — my goal was providing for my parents, family, and peace.
timestampedMemes.context: Islam reflects on real success: true satisfaction comes from taking care of hardworking parents, faith, and family rather than chasing material luxury.

shortsMemes.title: I eaty, I sleepy, I trainy (3-Step Champion Routine)
shortsMemes.quote: I eaty, I sleepy, I trainy.
shortsMemes.context: The simple 3-step daily routine of a Dagestani champion.

shortsMemes.title: Who gave him black belt? 🥋 (BJJ Credential Check)
shortsMemes.quote: Black belt? Who gave him — we have to check that moment.
shortsMemes.context: Questioning BJJ credentials of opponents after submission victories.

shortsMemes.title: Housekeeping! 🚪 (Fight Week Hotel Knock)
shortsMemes.context: Knocking on hotel room door during fight week.

shortsMemes.title: Brotha... WHO THIS GUY? 🤨
shortsMemes.context: The ultimate dismissive response to prospective contenders.

shortsMemes.title: English Is The Money Language 💵
shortsMemes.quote: Nobody understands what he says — English is the money language.
shortsMemes.context: Explaining why he learned English for press conferences.

shortsMemes.title: Somebody Already Cooked 🍳 (Camp Kitchen Philosophy)
shortsMemes.quote: Doesn't cook, just fries and mashes it — somebody already cooked.

shortsMemes.title: You Have To Tell Her. Not Ask 💍 (Advice to Volk on Dagestan)
shortsMemes.quote: You have to tell her. Not ask.
shortsMemes.context: Direct relationship advice to Volk about training in Dagestan.
